item.title: SPECIAL: CANNIBAL CROW - birthday stream 2025
item.description: December 14th Sun. 12:00 - 19:00 CET - CANNIBAL CROW - birthday stream Tune in: December 14th @ 12:00h CET December 14th is the birthday of Cannibal Crow, who passed away in 2014. As the founder of the Psycrowdelica Festival, he played a key role in the innovation of "modern psytrance." Following his vision, he brought together people and artists from all over the world to showcase the evolution of psytrance in all its facets.
